sentences.text: This Writ Petition has been filed challenging the seizure memo dated 28.07.2021 issued by the second respondent.
2. The petitioner is running a Alankar Zardha Scented Chewing Company and pursuant to inspection, the petitioners premises was sealed and goods were seized by the impugned order dated 28.07.2021.

The premises was kept under lock and seal and the petitioner approached this Court by filing W.P.No.9370 of 2022 seeking to hand over the key of the petitioners premises by considering his representation.

This Court disposed of the writ petition by giving a direction that the petitioner will have to retain the goods which have been seized, till the proceedings initiated against the petitioner attains a finality.

3. Now, the petitioner is before this Court challenging the seizure memo dated 28.07.2021 on the ground that the applicability of Section 3(1)
(j) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, does not apply to the petitioners business.
_ _ _ __ https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis

4. However, when the matter is taken up for hearing today, the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that it would suffice if this Court permits the petitioner to canvass all the points raised in this writ petition before the second respondent at the time of adjudication proceedings.

5. The learned counsel appearing for the respondents submitted that they have recovered the raw materials like tobacco, aricanut and cardamom, hence, it would fall under Section 2.3.4 of the Food Safety and Standards (Prohibition and Restrictions on Sales) Regulations, 2011 and if the petitioner is aggrieved against the seizure memo, there is an appeal remedy available to him under Rule 2.4.5 (1) of Food Safety and Standards Rules 2011.
6.

entities.text: Food Safety and Standards (Prohibition and Restrictions on Sales) Regulations, 2011
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
Considering the limited request made by the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner, this Court, without interfering with the seizure memo dated 28.07.2021 issued by the second respondent, permits the _________ https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 02/01/2026 04:37:10 pm ) petitioner to canvass all the points raised in this writ petition before the second respondent at the time of adjudication proceedings.
7.
Accordingly, this Writ Petition is disposed of.
There shall be no order as to costs.
Connected miscellaneous petition is closed.
